description: Resolve a campus place name, alias or code to element ids. Use before any tool that needs an id you were not given.
name: find_place

description: Current campus weather and air quality with data freshness. forecast=true adds the +1..+3 h frames.
name: campus_weather

description: Estimated thermal status (local temp, feels-like, UTCI, WBGT, risk, reasons) and scenario notices for 1-5 buildings.
name: building_status

description: Rank campus elements by an estimated thermal metric. order=hot lists the highest values first.
name: comfort_rank

description: Active road and building restriction scenarios (simulation scenarios, not official notices) and gate-counter parking state.
name: campus_status

description: Change the user's 3D view. focus: target=BLD_* id. view: target=overview|gate|d4|engineering|library|life-science|headquarters|humanities. tab: target=building|status (admins also energy|simulation). time: target=live or HH:MM KST. home: no target.
name: ui_action

description: Run Python in this session's persistent sandbox (state survives between calls, no network). Batch lookups in one cell: twin.get(uri), twin.get_many([uris]), twin.call(tool, **args), show(rows, cols, limit), save(name, text). Print only what you will cite.
name: eval

description: Read lines of a session file (spill/..., out/...) or a reference file (ref/...). Use it for truncated tool output.
name: read

description: Regex search in session files and ref/. Returns path:line:text.
name: search
